person.shortBio: Associate Full Stack Developer at Fountane, working with Next.js and Go. I own features end to end, and I'm currently building an AI chatbot agent that lets users query a large system in plain language.
longBio: I'm a software developer from Patna, India. I started building for the web while studying Computer Applications at Patna University, contributed to open source with Real Dev Squad, and joined Fountane in August 2024 as a Junior Full Stack Developer. I was recently promoted to Associate Full Stack Developer.

Day to day I work across Next.js and Go: UI with Ant Design, backend services and APIs, payment integrations, and role-based access control. I use AI tools like Claude, Cursor and Antigravity as part of how I build, and I'm now working on an AI chatbot agent that answers natural-language questions by calling internal APIs through an LLM.
Outside code I ride. I have ridden solo from Patna to Ladakh and from Patna to Rameshwaram, and I document the road, the people and the lessons on a separate Rides page.

projects.title: AI Chatbot Agent for a Property Management System
projects.visibilityNote: Work project: confirm with your employer what you may publish. Keep client names, screenshots with real data and internal API names out of the public site.
projects.summary: A backend service that lets front-desk and hotelier users ask questions in plain language and get answers pulled from 600+ APIs by an LLM.
projects.description: The system sits on top of a multi-service backend (Service 1 for configuration, Service 2 for bookings & operations, Service 3 for reporting, plus an auth service). The agent turns a natural-language question into the right API calls, filters data correctly (for example, a proper 'yesterday' window), and returns a readable answer. A next phase adds scheduled, event-based and condition-based routines with approval steps.
highlights: Built the chatbot backend service on top of an existing multi-service system.
Ran an AI-assisted audit to find implementation issues, then fixed them with manual verification.
Handled data-accuracy problems such as fixed reporting windows and missing user names in session data.
Drafted a phased plan for agent routines with approvals.
